description: Defines the interface for the Starboard Audio Sink API, including types, function prototypes, and constants for managing audio output sinks.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkIsValid
methods.description: Checks if the given audio sink handle is valid.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkCreate
methods.description: Creates an audio sink with specified parameters and callbacks.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkDestroy
methods.description: Destroys an audio sink and frees resources.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkGetMaxChannels
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported number of audio channels.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkGetNearestSupportedSampleFrequency
methods.description: Returns the closest supported sample rate to the requested frequency.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkIsAudioSampleTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific audio sample type is supported.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkIsAudioFrameStorageTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific audio frame storage type is supported.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkGetMinBufferSizeInFrames
methods.description: Returns the minimum buffer size in frames to avoid underflows.
